title: Biologic-biologic and biologic-JAK inhibitor combination therapy in refractory systemic autoinflammatory diseases.
snippet: Systemic autoinflammatory diseases (SAIDs) arise from genetic defects in innate immunity, leading to dysregulated activation of inflammatory pathways, including interleukin (IL)-1, IL-6, TNF, and JAK/STAT.
